cover_headline: Cato Amicus Brief Challenges $100,000 H-1B Fee in First Circuit Appeal
facts: The Cato Institute and professor Ilya Somin filed an amicus brief on November 12 in the First Circuit
A Massachusetts district court vacated the $100,000 payment on June 8, 2026
The First Circuit refused on July 24 to pause that ruling while the government appeals

end.headline: Cato Amicus Brief Challenges $100,000 H-1B Fee in First Circuit Appeal
end.line: Filed for the Cato Institute and professor Ilya Somin, the brief argues the payment is a tax only Congress can impose — while the fee itself remains vacated as the government appeals.
